title: Reject absurd todo titles and due dates
probes: Validation at a trust boundary — the one class of work that must never be simplified away. Error messages have to be specific enough to act on.
description:
As a todo user I want bad input rejected at the point I type it so that the file never holds something that breaks the list later.

`add` accepts any non-blank title and any parseable date. Add limits:

- A title longer than 200 characters is rejected, naming the limit and the actual length.
- A due date more than 100 years in the future or in the past is rejected as out of range, distinct from the existing invalid-date error.
- Leading and trailing whitespace keeps being trimmed, and a whitespace-only title keeps its current error.

Every rejection is an error with a non-zero exit, never a silently truncated value.
